reviews.title: It works!
reviews.comment: Works perfect for the Rode NT-USB mic. I ended up unscrewing the mic + half the attachment and screwed it into an adjustable boom arm. However, due to gravity, the out of the box mount adapter where the mic swivels ended up warping and snapping. Instead of the singular swivel part coming out of the Rode NT-USB box, this PIAOLGYI Microphone Mount Adapter has the two pieces that swivel. It fits like a glove to the out of the box attachment that is used to attach to the tripod (however, instead of the tripod I use a boom mic stand). With the two plastic pieces, it seems a lot sturdier than the one out of box. A big note and disclaimer is that this is only the mount adapter. It is not the piece that screws into the bottom of the microphone. Noting this, I ended up using a very small and thin screwdriver to pry out the piece from out of the box in the RODE NT USB mic mount adapter that spins/screws into the mic. It was a bit of challenge to pry it out, but once I did I was able to easily snap it onto the PIAOLGYI Mic Mount Adapter and get back to using my boom mic stand.
reviews.author: Artem Senchev

reviews.title: Original broke, replacement came broken
reviews.comment: This is the second one of these I bought. The first one broke while I was talking into the microphone. The second one came out of the packaging broken. It is in 4 pieces.
reviews.author: Richard davis

reviews.title: Worked for my RODE NT-USB
reviews.comment: After my original mount adapter snapped while unmounting my mic, I found this one and decided to give it a shot despite some reviews mentioning it doesn’t work or it is too brittle. Comparing my original adapter that snapped and this product, this products plastic material feels more sturdy and firm. I haven’t had any issues with the fit/attaching it to the microphones threaded ring or handling the mic/mic mount after getting everything setup. This product was/is $13 as of writing this review and I think it was/is a fair price for it.
reviews.author: Cole

reviews.title: Works with effort
reviews.comment: works well for rode NT-USB. however, product come without instructions, and modifications or original part was required; old part must be removed. I'd recommend either having a dermal to cut original part off, or plan to spend an hour prying it off with pliers.
